actionPosts.label: Action posts
actionPosts.helpText: If enabled, the app will action posts from users with a note on their account.

actionComments.label: Action comments
actionComments.helpText: If enabled, the app will action comments from users with a note on their account.

behaviorSettings.label: Behavior Settings
behaviorSettings.helpText: "Report" will flag content for review without removing it. "Filter" will remove content and send it for review. "Remove" will remove content without sending it for review.

spamWatchBehavior.label: Behavior for users with a "Spam Watch" note

spamWarningBehavior.label: Behavior for users with a "Spam Warning" note

abuseWarningBehavior.label: Behavior for users with an "Abuse Warning" note

banNoteBehavior.label: Behavior for users with a "Ban" note

noLabelBehavior.label: Behavior for users with a standard note (no label)

noLabelKeywords.label: Keywords for notes with no label
noLabelKeywords.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of keywords or phrases to check for in notes with no label. If left blank, every note will be considered.

maxNoteAgeDays.label: Ignore notes older than ___ days
maxNoteAgeDays.helpText: Ignore mod notes older than a certain amount of days. Set to 0 or less to respect all notes.

exemptApproved.label: Exempt approved users
exemptApproved.helpText: If enabled, the app will not action content from users who have been approved by mods.

createSpamWatchNote.label: Create "Spam Watch" note on spam removals
createSpamWatchNote.helpText: If enabled, a Spam Watch note will be created for the author whenever a post or comment is removed as spam.

createSpamWarningNote.label: Create "Spam Warning" note on spam removals
createSpamWarningNote.helpText: If enabled, a Spam Warning note will be created for the author whenever a post or comment is removed as spam. If both this and the above setting are enabled, the Spam Warning note will take priority.

createBanNote.label: Create "Ban" note on bans
createBanNote.helpText: If enabled, a Ban note will be created for a user when they are banned by a mod, even if the mod does not leave a note themselves.

modBlacklist.label: Mods to ignore
modBlacklist.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of moderator usernames (case-sensitive). Notes written by these mods will be ignored when actioning content, and new notes will NOT be automatically created for spam actions and bans made by these mods, even if the above settings are enabled. This could be useful if your subreddit has other apps/bots that write notes and action content. Do NOT include the leading "u/" (e.g., note-filter, not u/note-filter).
